blocks.title: Functional group
blocks.text: Functional group woh atom ya atoms ka group, ya double ya triple bond, hai jo organic compound ko us ki khaas khasiyatein deta hai.

Functional groups tabeei aur kimiyai dono khasiyaton par gehra asar karte hain. Methanol aur ethanol maaye (liquid) hain jab ke methane aur ethane gases, aur alcohols ke pighalne aur ubalne ke darje mutaliqa alkanes se zyada hain, kyunke hydroxyl group (-OH) hydrogen bonds bana sakta hai; alkanes mein aisa group nahi. Isi tarah chhote alcohols, carboxylic acids, glucose aur sucrose apne polar functional groups ki wajah se paani jaise polar solvents mein ghulte hain.

items: Bond order, yani group mein bonds ki tadaad (single, double ya triple).

blocks.text: Alkanes aur cycloalkanes mein koi functional group nahi: in mein na charge, na qabil-e-zikr polarity aur na double ya triple bonds hain.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol ka ubalne ka darja ethane se kaheen zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ka -OH group molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds banata hai; ethane mein koi functional group nahi aur molecules ke darmiyan sirf kamzor quwwatein hain.

items: Functional group: molecule ka woh hissa jo khasiyatein tay kare.
-OH hydrogen bonding deta: zyada ubalne ke darje aur paani mein hall pazeeri.
